name: DRS Rule
summary: Create a DRS affinity / anti-affinity rule between VMs, or a VM-Host rule.
description: VM-VM rules keep VMs together (affinity) or apart (anti-affinity). VM-Host rules create or reuse the DRS groups '<rule>-vms' and '<rule>-hosts' and bind them with a must / should (not) run on rule. Pre-checks: every VM runs in the cluster, hosts belong to the cluster, the rule name is free, and no enabled rule of the opposite type already contains two or more of the same VMs.

options.label: VM-Host: must not run on hosts
VM-Host: should not run on hosts

inputs.name: RuleName
inputs.label: Rule name
inputs.help: Unique in the cluster. VM-Host rules also name the DRS groups <rule>-vms and <rule>-hosts.

inputs.name: VMNames
inputs.label: Virtual machines
inputs.help: One per line or comma separated. VM-VM rules need at least 2 VMs; all must run in the cluster.

inputs.name: HostNames
inputs.label: Hosts
inputs.help: Only for VM-Host rules (ignored for VM-VM). One per line or comma separated; FQDN or short name.
